items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5885

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to authorize the Empire State Development
Corporation to acquire, by eminent domain, a certain parcel of real
property in the borough of Brooklyn; and to authorize the city of New
York to develop certain parkland

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Presents Legislative Findings. The legislature finds that
the 2005 Greenpoint-Williamsburg Waterfront Rezoning included city
commitments, and created an expectation in the community, that the
future Bushwick Inlet Park would include the parcel that is described
in section two of this act. The legislature further finds that these
commitments were included in the Environmental Impact Statement and
City Planning resolution prepared at that time and that the city
zoning map today shows the parcel to be parkland.

Section 2: Authorizes the Empire State Development Corporation, acting
through its board, to acquire by eminent domain the real property in
the borough of Brooklyn at North 11th Street, otherwise known on the
tax map of the City of New York as block 2287, lot 30, block 2294, lot
1, block 2294, lot 5 and block 2287, lot 16.

Section 3 establishes that the act shall take effect immediately.

JUSTIFICATION:

As part of a massive residential rezoning in 2005, the City agreed to
acquire the necessary parcels of land to build Bushwick Inlet Park.
In the decade since, the rezoning was completed, along with major
changes to the neighborhood, including thousands of new residents.
Yet, the City never made good on its promise to buy the land or fully
build the park. Statements from Administration officials give no
indication that the City has any intention of acquiring these
properties or completing full build out of the park, despite its
agreement to do so. This legislation would do what the City has
refused: acquire the relevant parcels for the purpose of fully
establishing the long-promised Bushwick Inlet Park.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

EFFECTIVE DATE:

Immediately

A.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5885A

TITLE OF BILL:

An act to authorize the Empire State Development Corporation to
acquire, by eminent domain, a certain parcel of real property in the
borough of Brooklyn; and to authorize the city of New York to develop
certain parkland

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Presents Legislative Findings. The legislature finds that
the 2005 Greenpoint-Williamsburg Waterfront Rezoning included city
commitments, and created an expectation in the community, that the
future Bushwick Inlet Park would include the parcel that is described

Section 2: Authorizes the Empire State Development Corporation, acting
through its board, to acquire by eminent domain the real property in
the borough of Brooklyn at North 11th Street, otherwise known on the
tax map of the City of New York as block 2287, lot 30, block 2294, lot
1, block 2294, lot 5 and block 2287, lot 16.

Section 3: States that this parcel of land shall be immediately
transferred to the city upon its acquisition by the Empire State
Development Corporation.

Section 4: Requires the city to honor its commitment to the community
by transforming such parcel into parkland. If the city fails to do so,
it will be required to deposit a sum of one million dollars, yearly,

which shall be administered by the office of parks, recreation and
historic preservation.

Section 5: Establishes that the act shall take effect immediately.

properties or completing full build out of the park, despite its
agreement to do so. This legislation would do what the City has
refused: acquire the relevant parcels for the purpose of fully
establishing the long-promised Bushwick Inlet Park.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill


FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

EFFECTIVE DATE:

Immediately
